items.title: After a deepfake voice fooled her grandfather, this founder sprang into action
items.feed_excerpt: After her grandfather was scammed by a deepfake of his brother's voice, Tarini Padmanabhuni founded DetectifAI, a San Francisco startup building AI models small enough to run directly on smartphones and flag fake voices in real time, and it's now one of the companies competing in Startup Battlefield at TechCrunch Disrupt.

items.title: Commonwealth Fusion Systems’ Brandon Sorbom and Helion’s David Kirtley on bringing fusion to the grid at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
items.feed_excerpt: CFS' Brandon Sorbom and Helion's David Kirtley join the Smart Systems Stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 to discuss the breakthroughs moving fusion forward, the challenges that remain, and what it will take to deliver fusion power to the grid at scale. items.title: ElevenLabs’ new v4 speech model supports more expression control and 90 languages
items.feed_excerpt: ElevenLabs v4 can clone voices with a 10 second clip

items.title: Viral AI agent Instinct raises $1B Series C at a $10B valuation
items.feed_excerpt: Instinct has raised a $1 billion Series C, saying 'we're just getting started.' The company is now valued at $10 billion.

items.title: AMD will acquire Fei-Fei Li’s World Labs for $8.2 billion
items.feed_excerpt: The acquisition will see World Labs founder Fei-Fei Li join AMD as executive vice president and chief scientist.

items.title: Shopify opens checkout to browser-based AI agents
items.feed_excerpt: Shopify is expanding WebMCP support to checkout, allowing browser-based AI agents to update order details and complete purchases with a buyer’s authorization.

items.title: Tesla delays Roadster 2 event again due to bad weather
items.feed_excerpt: Tesla says the event "can only be held outdoors," as it's expected to show the car flying in some form using SpaceX thrusters.

items.title: Peak XV ups Surge seed investment ceiling to $5M, unveils 18-startup cohort
items.feed_excerpt: Thirteen of the 18 startups in Peak XV’s latest Surge cohort are targeting global markets, while more than half are based in India.

items.title: Protego Ventures closes debut $125 million fund for Israeli defense tech
items.feed_excerpt: Protego Ventures, the first and largest dedicated defense tech VC in Israel, just completed its final $125 million closing, TechCrunch learned exclusively.

items.title: Ex-Tesla team raises $12.5M to put supply chains on autopilot
items.feed_excerpt: Atomic's agentic supply chain software is now being used by companies like DoorDash and HelloFresh.

items.title: Anthropic’s prospectus details losses, growth, and, yes, a warning that its AI could end humanity
items.feed_excerpt: In its prospectus, Anthropic just told investors it's losing tens of billions of dollars a year, but also growing like crazy, and — oh yeah — its own AI might pose an existential risk to humanity.
